notes: Overcast St. Petersburg skyline with a vivid rainbow: a building reads 'БАНК ГЛОБЭКС' (Bank Globex, a real Russian bank) with the tagline 'ГЛОБАЛЬНО. ИНДИВИДУАЛЬНО' ('Globally. Individually.') and a partial 'ЕЛЕКОМ' fragment above (likely a cropped 'Ростелеком'/Rostelecom sign); a small hanging yellow directional sign reads 'НА ПРИМОРСКИЙ ПР.' ('TO Primorsky Ave') with an arrow; power lines cross the frame; a stepped high-rise tower sits behind, rainbow arcing through the clouds on the right. UNCALIBRATED by design. CALIBRATED 2026-07-11 after first scored run: the '<language> text' must_not entries were removed — they correctly caught natural descriptive prose ('written in Chinese characters', alongside a CORRECT full transcription), which is good behavior, not the lazy-tag pattern they were meant to guard against. The REAL lazy-tag pattern (bare tags like 'korean text banners' with no actual transcription) showed up on the Korean/Russian entries specifically and is now fixed at the source in tag_filter.clean_tag (language+generic-textual-word tags dropped, same pattern as the existing watermark/overlay junk filter) rather than tracked per-entry.
